entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I need to return something. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I just... I really need the money back right now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number please?
It's Sarah Miller, and the order is... uh... VF78901. It's for the Apex Aero helmet.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here for the Apex Aero helmet, delivered about 49 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's nothing wrong with it, I'm sure it's great. It's just... the color wasn't what I expected from the pictures. It's been sitting in its box unopened this whole time. I feel so bad about it, but things are tight and I was counting on that money for other things.
I understand completely, Sarah. Thank you for clarifying. Since it's a preference and not a defect, let me just review our policy for you.
Oh, please. I was really hoping it wouldn't be a problem. I've always had such good experiences with VeloFit.

Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like standard items, like this helmet, are eligible for a full refund within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 49, you are well within that window for a return.
Really? Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. You have no idea.

Of course. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially when it comes to the safety and comfort of your gear. I've just initiated the return for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Just pack the helmet back up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you, Alex. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Once we receive the item, you can expect the refund to process within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
